enforcement_limits.native_fields: Exact org, subject, institution, role, key/revision/fingerprint, action, permission, nonempty validity and enabled state.
enforcement_limits.no_new_field_claim: Existing V040 has no package_id/deployment/incarnation/environment/single-signature counter columns. Single-purpose/nonproduction/nontransferability require isolated custody + approved allocation/local datasource, one-signature ceremony inventory, independent original and later existing host-binding governance. Descriptive reason/provenance alone are not a cryptographic package restriction.

disable_plan.trigger: Same end-of-proof event as key retirement, or bounded approved validity expiry; append DISABLED authority revision with exact predecessor and immutable scope. New effect acceptance already denies outside validUntil.

snapshots.canonicalization: UTF8 sorted-key compact JSON; explicitly ordered catalog arrays; SHA256; no password/verifier or key_material read.
